title: Artisan Project Source
description: A data/<source_id>.yaml file: a self-contained Project source. Its Data model is inlined in `fields`; the server never sees model identities.

schema.description: Schema version. Fixed, so that migrations can apply on load.

id.description: Stable id of the source. Menus reference it as `pack:<id>`.

name.description: Display name in the editor. Ignored by the server.

shape.description: table: a list of rows (iterated or placed); config: a single object read through placeholders.

model.description: Tables only: the Data model (models/<id>.yaml) that types this source in the editor. A namespaced id (ns:model) is a model declared by an add-on. The server ignores it and reads `fields`.

model_version.description: Version of the declared model the rows were written with; the editor migrates them when it lags behind. Ignored by the server.

key_field.description: Tables only: the top-level scalar field that identifies each row. Placements anchor on it.

granularity.description: One file per row: this is the `_source.yaml` of a `data/<id>/` folder, the rows live next to it (one file per row key) and `rows:` is absent.

order.description: Order of the row files (one file per row). A file added by hand outside this list is appended, sorted by name.

fields.description: The fields of the rows (table) or of the object (config). Models are inlined, no refs.

rows.description: The rows of a table. ltext values are i18n keys (resolved through lang/); item values are a material or `item:<id>`.

value.description: The object of a config. Same value conventions as rows.

kind.description: ltext: an i18n key, resolved in the player's language; item: a material (`DIAMOND`, `item:<id>` or a custom ref); actions: an action chain of steps (a legacy DSL string is still read); map: key → value; enum: a string from a closed set; union: a variant chosen by `tag`. No `model` here: it is inlined, the file stays self-contained.

of.description: Type of the items (kind=list) or of the values (kind=map).

tag.description: The field that picks the variant (kind=union only).
